name: german_credit_lr
title: German Credit Bayesian Logistic Regression
description: Bayesian logistic regression for the UCI Statlog German credit data (1000 customers, 24 standardized numeric predictors), as used in the empirical evaluation of the No-U-Turn Sampler (Hoffman and Gelman, 2014, Section 4.1.2). The binary response indicates whether a customer is a good (1) or bad (0) credit risk. The intercept and the 24 regression coefficients are given independent weakly informative normal priors with mean 0 and variance 100 (standard deviation 10). The posterior has 25 parameters and serves as a relatively well-conditioned baseline.
